// diagnostic

E0614

`.{name}` isn't a member of `#{marker}`.

What

`.{name}` isn't a member of `#{marker}`.

Why

Inside a marker block a `.name { … }` statement must name one of that marker's declared members. `#{marker}` understands: {list}.

Fix

use one of the listed members, or remove the block.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0614: tests/ui/scope_member_unknown.stderr.

Error [E0614]: `.warmup` isn't a member of `#Test`
  --> tests/ui/scope_member_unknown.jet:6:5
    |
  6 |     .warmup {
    |     ^
 Why: a `#Test` block understands these members: `.setup`, `.expect_fail`, `.timeout`, `.skip`, `.measure`, `.cases`
 Fix: use one of `.setup`, `.expect_fail`, `.timeout`, `.skip`, `.measure`, `.cases`, or remove this block
